title: Arithmetic Operators
code:
a = 5
b = 3

print(a + b)
print(a - b)
print(a * b)
print(a / b)
print(a ** b)
print(a % b)
print(a//b)

lines.explanation: Assigning the integer '5' to the variable 'a'
Assigning the integer '3' to the variable 'b'
This is the addition operator. It arithmetically adds the two integers and prints out the value. In this case it will print out the value '8' (5+3=8)
This is the subtraction operator. It arithmetically subtracts the two integers and prints out the value. In this case it will print out the value '2' (5-3=2)
This is the multiplication operator. It arithmetically multiplies the two integers and prints out the value. In this case it will print out the value '15' (5*3=15)
This is the division operator. It arithmetically divides the two integers and prints out the value. In this case it will print out the value '1.667' (5/3=1.667)
This is the exponent operator. It arithmetically exponents the two integers and prints out the value. In this case it will print out the value '125' (5 to the power 3 = 125)
This is the modulus operator. It arithmetically takes modulus of a variable with the other and prints out the value. In this case it will print out the value '2' (5 modulus 3 = 2)

This is the floor division operator. It arithmetically floor divides the two integers and prints out the value. Floor division is actually dividing without taking into consideration the remainder. In this case it will print out the value '1' (5 floor divided by 3 = 1)
